objective: Add one bounded independent pre-draft candidate-closure audit so corpus-wide legal work reopens omitted or unsupported candidates before answer-set selection, without restoring heuristic finish blocking.

evidence: debugger/overview.md: 52 of 80 diagnoses share the candidate-set-closure failure family
evidence/tasks/e2d949cc878835d3.json: repeated broad-census closure without an independently tested answer set
changes.failure_pattern: The lead agent often surfaced plausible matter roots but then omitted them, closed them from filenames or partial sources, or treated a populated ledger as proof that the candidate set was complete.
changes.mechanism: A registered read-only reviewer receives the user gates, cardinality, ledger, and completed discovery routes, then independently tests recall and closure quality with bounded read/glob/grep access and returns source-bound discrepancies for the lead to resolve.
changes.rationale: Repeated prompt and middleware ledger reminders made state visible but could not independently challenge the lead's own premature closure; a bounded sub-agent supplies the missing independent search-and-review pass while remaining unable to overwrite deliverables or decide the final answer.

changes.failure_pattern: The lead's own pre-draft self-check did not reliably discover omitted candidates or change a mechanically reconciled answer set.
changes.mechanism: The lead protocol now calls the independent reviewer exactly once at the post-reconciliation transition, supplies a concrete audit packet, and requires candidate-local resolution of every discrepancy before drafting.
changes.rationale: The root system prompt is the routing surface that controls when to delegate, what context crosses the boundary, how results are integrated, and when named-file work must skip the added cost.

evidence: attribution/C8/transition.json: chg-2 and chg-3 had partial gains but repeated candidate omissions and unsupported exclusions remained
changes.failure_pattern: Candidate designation and reconciliation were used as bookkeeping: neutral census roots could be prepopulated and designated roots could be closed without a completed candidate-local source read.
changes.mechanism: The workflow defines designation as a source-review obligation, forbids neutral census prepopulation and filename-only closure, specifies the reviewer packet, and requires the lead to verify discrepancies from candidate-local evidence.
changes.rationale: The registered skill is the progressively disclosed surface for the detailed designation, closure, reviewer-integration, and final-verification procedure.

validation: nexau-evolution-guide validate_agent.py: valid with only the expected local NexAU import warning
candidate validation: adapter policy, schema, syntax, and NexAU smoke checks passed with one registered sub-agent
